query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocked_ips (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  reason VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Razón del bloqueo',
  blocked_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  expires_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT 'NULL = bloqueo permanente',
  INDEX idx_ip_address (ip_address),
  INDEX idx_expires_at (expires_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='IPs bloqueadas por actividad sospechosa';
